reviews.title: Dodgy advert
reviews.text:
I love this app to bits it’s amazing for studying and ad placement Is frequent but well placed. However, I received an advert saying “your account has been restricted we have detected that your account has been hacked visiting adult websites . Solution visit the App Store…..

This was an advert not an in app message, and I was able to press the corner “x” this is what made it clear to me that it’s dodgy but others, specifically younger users, are likely to panic and download a virus off of an app they trust. I think it should be made aware that this is a circulating advert especially on this app

reviews.title: Ads

reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.text: This app used to be perfect; the only annoying feature was not being able to purchase the same furniture more than once. Its now quite literally unusable due to the amount of ads. Every button you click will give you ad. Some of them are over half a minute long and you can’t skip them. A low battery warning popped up on my phone today and the app decided that was yet another reason to give me an ad. It’s just ridiculous. Oh and you still can’t buy a furniture item or any item from the catalogue more than once. The only reason I’m refraining myself from giving it one star is that the progress board is still a great way to track all your study time for each individual subject. Other than that it’s terrible!

reviews.title: TOO MANY ADDS!!
reviews.text:
My friend recommended it to me and I thought it’d be good but… the adds??? Hello??! Every time you’re using the app and switch the screen off there’s an add when you turn it back on; which is infuriating. Then you finish the timer.. and guess what? Another add! They’re fairly long adds as well. Also the app doesn’t work offline which is pathetic because it’s just a timer. The tracking bit is nice, but the adds are very distracting, it seems counterintuitive with all the adds: it’s supposed to be a FOCUS app but the focus is broken by the adds. I wouldn’t download it, there are other apps that do similar things, just find them. Without the adds I’d be it’d be a great app, but the adds ruin it. At this point, just make an extremely simplistic version of it for free with no adds, and then make the real version available if paid - food for thought. Anyone saying it’s good with all the apps is genuinely deluded. 

Yours sincerely, 

A year 11 who is very stressed <3 💕

reviews.title: Just bad
reviews.text:
It used to be really good; I used it all the time. It had a few bugs, but nothing too serious. Over the last few weeks, though, it started draining my battery badly, running in the background even when the app was closed. There was no option to stop background activity, so I ended up having to delete it.

On top of that, the new iOS update doesn’t work well with the app’s design. The close button on ads is often cut off, and sometimes I have to restart the app entirely for it to work properly. If these issues were fixed, I’d happily come back, but considering they’ve been around for years now, I don’t really see that happening.
